notes: Fiscal year ended January 31, 2025 (CrowdStrike's fiscal 2025; matches data.js fy 'Jan 2025'). Financial figures are from the FY2025 Form 10-K (accession 0001535527-25-000009), checked against SEC XBRL; ownership is from the 2025 proxy (DEF 14A filed May 6, 2025, accession 0001104659-25-045047), as of April 15, 2025. LEADER: the proxy states George Kurtz's 6,321,555 shares as 2.53% of the 249,063,280 Class A shares outstanding. That total includes 4,245,383 shares held by trusts with an independent trustee (shared voting and dispositive power), 100,000 shares held by the Kurtz Family Dynasty Trust, 135,000 PSU shares vesting within 60 days and 351,989 options exercisable within 60 days; 1,489,183 shares were held of record by him. HOLDERS: Vanguard's figure is as of September 30, 2024 and BlackRock's as of December 31, 2023 (stale), per the 13G filings the proxy cites. BUYBACKS: the cash-flow statement shows no repurchases of common stock in fiscal 2025. STOCK COMP: the note total equals the cash-flow add-back ($865.421 million); the later FY2026 filing shows $861.391 million for this year, but the snapshot-year filing's figure is used.
